surface_description: User supplied: 3mm textured PVC flooring over plywood

isaac_pair_convention.note: Unit wheel friction is a contact-pair factorization, not measured bare-tire friction. Use multiply for friction and max for restitution, wheel restitution0/ground0.02. Bind wheel-only materials and audit both combine modes and runtime values before activation; other body contacts unchanged.

curriculum.gate: frozen checkpoint comparison, progressive training, retention; no automatic promotion
curriculum.activation_gate: After isolated last-three tracking repairs and random command-domain validation; retain original terrain regression

mujoco.restitution_mapping: No direct PhysX restitution scalar equivalent; preserve baseline solref/solimp until contact validation

reset_randomization.scope: wheel-ground effective contact coefficients, shared severity per env and both wheels, re-sampled at reset
reset_randomization.factorization: unchanged actual ground; dedicated wheel multiply/max material carries per-env target contact pair
reset_randomization.baseline: effective pair derived from original wheel binding and actual terrain material combine modes
reset_randomization.activation: opt-in after current run; engineering prior, no automatic promotion or behavior certification
